items.title: Proof transaction dashboard

items.title: Vault template gallery
items.why: Wallet safety is the easiest concrete covenant use case to understand.

items.title: Escrow primitive
items.why: Merchant and service flows need conditional release/refund before full DeFi.

items.title: Assurance campaign page
items.why: Public funding rules are useful before pooled vProgs exist.

items.title: Accepted transaction indexer
items.why: Apps need durable state from accepted transactions, not just submitted txids.

items.title: Simple asset rule demo
